scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:mini && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm --workspace @naqlah/shared-types run typecheck && npm --workspace @naqlah/validation run typecheck && npm --workspace @naqlah/config run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/mini-app run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint:packages && npm run lint:apps
scripts.lint:packages: npm --workspace @naqlah/shared-types run lint && npm --workspace @naqlah/validation run lint && npm --workspace @naqlah/config run lint
scripts.lint:apps: npm --workspace apps/api run lint && npm --workspace apps/web run lint && npm --workspace apps/mini-app run lint
